messages:
Maria Nguyen: Heads-up — Compliance asked to shorten staging auth-log retention from 400d -> 90d and to enable daily SIEM exports to a partner cluster. Need to confirm KMS unwrap, RBAC, and forensics impact before we change.
Chris Patel: Staging only? or prod too?
Maria Nguyen: Staging only for now. Prod remains 400d unless legal requests a change.
Devon Lee: For the exporter, service account needs kms:Decrypt on the CMK that wraps exported blobs. Example IAM condition we use (inline for runbook): ```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01"
}```
Also recommend pushing export credentials to Secrets Manager and rotating monthly.
Jamal Ortiz: 90d in staging is probably ok, but incident triage may need older context. Proposal: keep 7d hot in SIEM, 90d cold, and create monthly cold snapshots encrypted and access-controlled for up to 2 years.
Priya Rao: Compliance OK with 90d for staging. If you produce cold snapshots, implement a legal_hold flag so we can extend retention case-by-case.
SRE Oncall: Changing retention reduces cost but will impact any runbooks referencing >90d searches. Schedule the change in a low-traffic window and update runbooks. Also add monitoring for missed exports.
Maria Nguyen: Mitigation plan: 7d hot, roll to 90d cold, monthly encrypted archives with access restricted to Forensics. Access via short-lived KMS grant only after ticketed approval.
Devon Lee: Workflow: PR to infra-opa to add RBAC for exporter SA, PR for granting Forensics role kms:Decrypt scoped to archive CMK. Grants must go through reviewers and be logged.
Jamal Ortiz: For KMS unwrap, prefer ticketed approval that issues a short-lived STS role via OPA session. No permanent kms:Decrypt grants to people. Audit trail must capture requester, approver, reason, CMK id, and unwrap timestamp.
Maria Nguyen: I'm drafting the runbook with STS example and required audit fields.
Chris Patel: I can run the first export & acceptance test Wed 02:00 UTC (low traffic).
sec-bot: Security request SEC-2026-451 created by Maria Nguyen for "staging retention change + partner SIEM export" — https://redwood.company/requests/SEC-2026-451 :eyes: 
Maria Nguyen: Thanks — I'll attach the runbook and minimal IAM/CMK snippets. Anything else before I open the change window? :lock:
SRE Oncall: Add temporary pager rules for export failures for the first 48h and ensure export latency alerts are enabled.
Priya Rao: Confirm legal_hold tag optional param on snapshots.
Jamal Ortiz: Add forensic integrity checklist to runbook: hash verification, manifest, CMK id logged.
Maria Nguyen: Will post runbook and change timeline in #sec once PRs are up. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Chris Patel: :+1:
Devon Lee: :lock:
